Iris (DevRel): idea: run a QuickForge MiniLab — 2 short hands-on tutorials, 1 reference app, + a compact benchmark post. single registration funnel, 30-min webinar demo. aim = developer signups + repo engagement. who wants in?
Noah (Growth): yes. KPIs: webinar RSVPs, repo forks, trial starts. target conversion funnel numbers?
Lina (Content): propose assets: 1 launch post, 2 tutorial posts with GIF steps, short FAQ, social microcopy. I'll draft copy.
Omar (PMM): benchmark angle: show cost delta with Optimize presets and show baseline vs quantized run. hero stat + reproducible command. keep it dev-friendly.
Jules (Design): I can do hero image + 3 card GIF templates. need final assets 48h before publish.
ci-bot: created: drive.redwood.ai/quickforge/ (starter-repo, slide-deck, asset-pack)
Iris (DevRel): routing plan: tag leads `quickforge_*`; segments: visited-tutorial, registered-webinar, forked-repo. route high-engagement to AE trial queue.
Noah (Growth): add UTMs and hidden field on form: `utm_campaign=quickforge_minilab`. segmentation rules OK.
Lina (Content): draft social: "QuickForge MiniLab: ship an LLM-powered search + rerank in 30 mins. RSVP." email subject: "Ship a mini LLM feature in one short lab"
Omar (PMM): bench command: `./bench.sh --model rwd-small --seq 256 --batch 16 --quantize true` will publish raw logs in repo. hero stat draft: "~35% lower token cost using Optimize preset: latency-neutral."
Jules (Design): thumbs: 1:1 square + 1200x630 blog hero. uploading v1 now.
Iris (DevRel): owners: Lina=copy + blog, Omar=bench + repo config, Jules=design, Noah=distribution + routing, me=webinar ops + repo maintainer.
Noah (Growth): timeline: Day0 announce + tutorial #1, Day3 tutorial #2 + RSVP push, Day6 webinar + benchmark post. compress if needed.
Lina (Content): checklist: README quickstart, 2 gifs, sample inputs, bench logs, CTA (star + trial). PR entry later today.
ci-bot: opened PR: github.com/redwood-inference/quickforge/pull/7 (initial tutorial + assets)
Iris (DevRel): small ops: include `source=quickforge` in payloads. @ci-bot set 24h reminder before publish.
Noah (Growth): I'll wire form + analytics, set tags and Slack alert for high-engagement leads.
Omar (PMM): will prep 2-slide "how we measured" for the webinar and short appendix in repo with raw commands.
Lina (Content): need hero stat sign-off before scheduling.
Iris (DevRel): OK team — add ETAs to PR and flag blockers by EOD. excited to move fast on this.
